concerns.concern: Most of the diffraction evidence cannot tell orthorhombic Bmab from monoclinic P21/c. The (½,½,0) superlattice peaks, the hk0 splitting and broadening, and the centering-violating twin spots all occur in both. The phase-diagram points therefore mark the loss of tetragonal symmetry, not the onset of monoclinicity.
concerns.quote: The experimental observables used do not discriminate Bmab from P21/c.

concerns.concern: The remaining evidence for monoclinicity is weak. The β−90° deviation is negligible at 300 K, and the lower R-factor for B21/a is expected anyway because it has more parameters. The authors should show reflections allowed in B21/a but forbidden in Bmab, rule out twin overlap and multiple diffraction, and use a Hamilton test with identical twin models.
concerns.quote: B21/a has more refinable parameters, so a lower R is expected regardless of whether the extra freedom is physical.

concerns.concern: The Landau picture is internally inconsistent: the transition is called both weak first-order and continuous. A direct I4/mmm→P21/c transition generically needs two irreducible representations, which makes an intermediate Bmab window the generic alternative. A symmetry-mode decomposition is requested.
concerns.quote: The text calls the transition both "weak first-order" (jump in β at onset, p. 8) and "continuous bypassing the orthorhombic phase"

concerns.concern: The simultaneous vanishing of the order parameters rests on a three-point fit on a 1 GPa grid, so a Bmab window narrower than about 1 GPa is not excluded. Fine-grid enthalpy differences between constrained Bmab and P21/c relaxations are needed, resolvable against the stated convergence.
concerns.quote: A Bmab window narrower than about 1 GPa is not excluded.

concerns.concern: Hysteresis should be checked experimentally, on compression versus decompression at 300 K and on heating versus cooling in the PXRD data.
concerns.quote: check for hysteresis experimentally, on compression versus decompression at 300 K and on heating/cooling in the PXRD data of Fig. S1.

concerns.concern: The conclusion that superconductivity emerges only in the tetragonal phase is unsupported, because no transport or susceptibility was measured on these crystals. Reported superconducting onsets below about 14 GPa would fall inside the monoclinic region.
concerns.quote: The conclusion that superconductivity emerges only in the tetragonal phase is not supported by this work.

concerns.concern: The authors' room-temperature transition pressure of 10.5 GPa disagrees with the roughly 15 GPa cited in the literature, and this discrepancy is not discussed.
concerns.quote: The authors' room-temperature boundary is 10.5 GPa. The Introduction cites ≈15 GPa for the room-temperature transition (Refs. 19–22). This discrepancy is not discussed

concerns.concern: The Raman polarizations are not aligned with crystal axes, so Ag and Bg modes leak into both channels and the '31 modes > 24 Ag' argument fails. Only a three-mode margin in the total count remains, and twin domains further mix the tensor components.
concerns.quote: The "31 modes in parallel > 24 Ag" argument then fails, because up to 48 modes may appear in YY.

concerns.concern: The new low-temperature Raman modes could have other origins that must be excluded: zone folding from an incommensurate density wave, amplitude modes, two-phonon features, or impurity and intergrowth phases such as La2NiO4, NiO and La3Ni2O7.
concerns.quote: Each of these could produce a few new low-temperature modes and needs to be excluded

concerns.concern: A loss of inversion symmetry (Pc/P21) predicts that the new modes coincide with IR phonon frequencies and that second-harmonic generation appears; neither is checked. The 'third structural phase' should therefore be presented as a hypothesis.
concerns.quote: A k=0 loss of inversion predicts that the new modes coincide with IR phonon frequencies and that SHG appears. Neither is checked.

concerns.concern: The density-wave transition is not demonstrated in these flux-grown crystals: no resistivity, susceptibility or heat-capacity data are shown, and the oxygen content is not determined.
concerns.quote: no resistivity, susceptibility or heat-capacity data are shown; the oxygen content is not determined (EPMA gives only La:Ni)

concerns.concern: The XRD null result for density-wave satellites is not quantified. An upper bound on satellite intensity and the dynamic range and counting statistics of the data are needed.
concerns.quote: give an upper bound on satellite intensity relative to main and (½,½,0)-type reflections at the wavevectors reported in Ref. 25

concerns.concern: The 80 K diffraction data should be reanalyzed for violations of the 21 screw axis or the c-glide, with non-centrosymmetric refinements and Friedel-pair differences, to test Pc versus P21 directly.
concerns.quote: The DESY data at 80 K could also directly test Pc and P21.

concerns.concern: The low-temperature phase-boundary points at 80 K and 20 K lack stated criteria and pressure brackets. It is unclear which data fix the 13 GPa point at 80 K, and the Fig. 4 boundaries appear near 14 GPa.
concerns.quote: It is unclear which intermediate data fix it, and the boundaries in Fig. 4 (80 and 20 K panels) appear to lie near 14 GPa.

concerns.concern: The claimed linear suppression of the boundary rests on only four points, with large gaps in the data, and should be presented only as a guide.
concerns.quote: The "linear suppression" rests on four points with no data between 0 and 10.5 GPa or above 300 K under pressure; describe it as a guide only.

concerns.concern: The ruby temperature correction at 80 and 20 K is not specified, nor whether pressure was changed at low temperature.
concerns.quote: Specify the ruby temperature correction applied at 80 and 20 K, and whether pressure was changed at low temperature.

concerns.concern: The uncertainties on β and the lattice parameters appear statistical only. Systematic errors from overlapping twin domains and limited DAC coverage could be comparable to the measured β deviation, and the handling of domain overlap is not described.
concerns.quote: systematic errors in β of order 0.05–0.1° are plausible. This is comparable to the 300 K values in Fig. 4b.

concerns.concern: DFT details are missing: the magnetic configuration, the smearing, k-point convergence of energy differences, and sensitivity to the functional or a +U correction.
concerns.quote: the magnetic configuration (non-spin-polarized or otherwise), given the SDW

concerns.concern: The quoted DFT critical pressure conveys false precision given the acknowledged 1–3 GPa PBE offset, and the static T=0 calculation is compared with finite-temperature data.
concerns.quote: The quoted Pc = 16.47 ± 0.04 GPa conveys false precision; the main text itself estimates a 1–3 GPa PBE offset.

concerns.concern: The 80 K tilt angle is smaller than the 300 K value at low pressure, opposite to the expected trend on cooling. The 80 K data also stop well below the claimed boundary, which makes the agreement with the DFT square-root law hard to assess.
concerns.quote: This is opposite to the expected increase of distortion on cooling and needs comment.

concerns.concern: There are tilt-data inconsistencies. The 171.1° angle quoted at 6 GPa should be checked against the plotted 300 K value, and 'the octahedra is perfect' contradicts the stated strong distortion (presumably 'untilted' is meant).
concerns.quote: "At 15 GPa, the octahedra is perfect" conflicts with the preceding statement that the octahedra are strongly distorted.

concerns.concern: The bulk modulus changes unusually much between 300 K and 80/20 K. The authors should state whether K′ was fixed, the fit range, whether points from both phases were included, and the K0–K′ correlation.
concerns.quote: K0 changes from 155(4) GPa at 300 K to 182–185 GPa at 80/20 K, which is unusually large for this temperature range.

concerns.concern: The density-wave transition temperature is quoted inconsistently (135 K, 130 K, ~120 K, 120–150 K).
concerns.quote: T_DW is quoted inconsistently: 135 K in the abstract, 130 K in the text

concerns.concern: The subgroup chain mixes standard and non-standard settings and omits indices; explicit transformation matrices are needed.
concerns.quote: mixes standard and non-standard settings and omits indices

concerns.concern: Fig. 2a uses different reflections at different temperatures, which complicates comparison of the splittings.
concerns.quote: Fig. 2a uses different reflections at different temperatures (4 6 0, 6 4 0, −2 6 0), which complicates comparison of splittings.

concerns.concern: The Fig. 4 caption range does not match the axes. Fig. 1 should also clarify that the DFT point is a static T=0 result subject to the pressure offset.
concerns.quote: The Fig. 4 caption gives a 0–16 GPa range while the axes extend to 20 GPa.

concerns.concern: High-temperature PXRD up to 1223 K may involve oxygen loss. The authors should state whether the transition is reversible and whether the oxygen content was checked afterwards.
concerns.quote: The high-temperature PXRD up to 1223 K may involve oxygen loss (cf. Ref. 23).

concerns.concern: Raman methods lack the spot size, the orientation determination, and how the laser-heated sample temperature was estimated.
concerns.quote: give the spot size, the orientation determination, and how the 26 K laser-heated temperature was estimated.

concerns.concern: Overuse of 'unequivocally' should be toned down.
concerns.quote: "unequivocally" is used repeatedly; tone it down

concerns.concern: Several typos and formatting errors need correction, including misspelled names and lower-case chemical formulas in references.
concerns.quote: "propoposal", "PsuedoDojo"; "Gabarino" versus "Garbarino"
